Author: hiarc
Name: Ostinato
Description: Swaps the pressed action for the next step of your rotation, using per-job rules you can switch on and off.
TestingChangelog:
Test build for PR #24: M125–M128: helper reuse, compiler as null check + code-style guard, README as reference, one action sheet (cleanup S10, final)

1. "Has my Lucid Dreaming" is no longer offered as a Route target on SMN and SGE; nothing used it.
2. After updating you will see one "encyclopedia changed" row the first time the plugin loads. It does not come back.
3. The plugin package is smaller: the per-job action sheets are now one shared file.

Minor: internal cleanup only. The build now refuses null hand-offs and dead private code. Duplicate helpers are merged. The README is rewritten as a reference, with the history moved to docs/HISTORY.md.
